verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no native auto top-up or low-balance alert feature. A finance lead could only assemble one: AgentOS can read balances, the Transfers API can move funds to your own accounts, and webhooks push real-time event notifications. This is a do-it-yourself workaround, not a delivered capability. Missing for 10: native auto top-up rules between accounts, configurable low-balance alerts, documented balance-threshold webhook events, and independent corroboration.
